svg.aria-label: How a routing rule's sniff action recognises a protocol without changing the stream
svg.title: How a sniff action recognises a protocol without changing the stream

g.text: into a buffer of at most 16 KiB
the first sniffer to answer wins
on a result, no sniffer left,
16 KiB full, EOF or the deadline
first, then the rest of the stream
Metadata.Destination is never rewritten from a sniff result.
Sniffers never change the bytes: they only trim what they read. The client's bytes reach the outbound exactly as sent.
Sniffing is TCP only. It runs only when a routing rule's sniff action is reached: rules before it never wait.
